cpu-amd-zen5.title: AMD Launches Ryzen 7 9800X3D Processor site:ir.amd.com - Google Search
cpu-amd-zen5.headline: The Gaming Legend Continues — AMD Introduces Next-Generation AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D Processor
cpu-amd-zen5.subheadline: Powered by "Zen 5" architecture and 2nd Gen AMD 3D V-Cache technology, delivering up to 5.2 GHz boost clock.
cpu-amd-zen5.quote: "With the introduction of the Ryzen 7 9800X3D processor, built on our advanced 'Zen 5' architecture, we are elevating gaming performance like never before."
cpu-amd-zen5.quoteAuthor: — Jack Huynh, Senior Vice President and GM, Computing and Graphics, AMD
highlights: Built on 2nd Generation AMD 3D V-Cache technology placing 64MB SRAM underneath CPU cores.
Native full 512-bit vector execution pipeline for AVX-512 math.
Average 16% IPC improvement over Zen 4 architecture with 5.2 GHz max boost clock.
Integrated 2 CU RDNA 2 iGPU for display output and hardware AV1 decode.

cpu-intel-arrow-lake.title: Intel Core Ultra 200S Series Desktop Processors press release site:newsroom.intel.com - Google Search
cpu-intel-arrow-lake.headline: Intel Launches Core Ultra 200S Series Desktop Processors: First AI PC Desktop Platform
cpu-intel-arrow-lake.subheadline: Disaggregated Foveros 3D tiles slash package power by up to 33% while introducing dedicated NPU 3 engine.
cpu-intel-arrow-lake.quote: "The new Intel Core Ultra 200S series processors scale to deliver on our goals to significantly reduce power consumption while maintaining outstanding gaming performance."
cpu-intel-arrow-lake.quoteAuthor: — Robert Hallock, Intel Vice President & GM, Client AI & Technical Marketing

specs.label: Packaging Technology
specs.val: TSMC N3B + N6 + N5 on Intel Foveros 3D

highlights: Lion Cove P-cores and Skymont E-cores built on disaggregated Foveros 3D tiles.
Up to 33% lower package power consumption in gaming and creation workloads.
First Intel desktop processor family featuring a dedicated Neural Processing Unit (NPU 3).
Integrated Intel Graphics tile with 4 Xe-Cores, ray tracing, and XeSS upscaling.
